title: Bobby Fischer's claim that Russian parapsychologists interfered with his games

tellings.quote: Bobby Fischer was tired of saying that the Russians did this to him. Bobby Fischer, look it up. That he would play and they would come in and there were gurus, Russian parasychologists

plain: A surgeon named Italo Venturelli, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the chess champion Bobby Fischer kept complaining that the Russians interfered with his games around 1974. According to Venturelli, Fischer said that while he played, the Russians brought in gurus, parapsychologists who study mind powers, to work on him. If true, it would mean a government used mental powers as a weapon at the chess board.
